name: Helix Industrial Group
description: Helix designs and manufactures propulsion systems, advanced alloys and commercial spacecraft components.
history: Helix began as a propulsion component manufacturer and expanded through acquisitions into advanced materials and integrated commercial spacecraft systems.
culture: Operationally disciplined, engineering-led and strongly focused on reliability, supplier qualification and long production runs.
reputation: Demanding but dependable commercial partner with high technical standards.

visualIdentity.uniforms: Dark graphite workwear with narrow bronze identity bands
visualIdentity.architecture: Low angular industrial halls with bronze wayfinding
visualIdentity.shipLivery: Graphite hulls with narrow bronze striping

image.promptDescription: Corporate logo for Helix Industrial Group, angular engineering identity, graphite and bronze, clean sci-fi industrial branding.

name: Verdant Horizon Biotech
description: Verdant Horizon develops closed-habitat crops, nutritional cultures and biological support systems for remote settlements and long-duration industrial colonies.
history: Founded by habitat biologists and agricultural engineers, Verdant grew around practical food-security research rather than pharmaceutical megaprojects.
culture: Collaborative, research-led and cautious about biological risk, with close relationships between procurement, field science and production teams.
reputation: Specialist organisation valued for practical colony-grade biological systems.

visualIdentity.uniforms: White technical clothing with dark green panels
visualIdentity.architecture: Rounded clean-room modules and transparent growth galleries
visualIdentity.shipLivery: White hulls with dark green scientific markings

image.promptDescription: Corporate logo for Verdant Horizon Biotech, abstract leaf-cell motif, soft white and botanical green, clean scientific identity.
